_readme: THE PRACTICE'S EMAIL IS NOT HERE. It is in data/contact.json, where Contact reads it,
and build/lib/careers.js reads the same value from the same place. The address appears
in this page's paragraph and (eventually) in its handler; one fact, one source. The
menu overlay in partials/header.html still hardcodes its own copy — that is a known
second source, watched by _bmad/tools/sweep-contact.js rather than fixed here.
THE ROUTE DOES NOT EXIST YET, and that is stated rather than hidden. There is no
php/careers.php in the tree: php/contact.php is a five-field message handler that
would silently drop a CV, and it fatals on PHP 8 besides. The form is the forms
phase's to connect, and this file is where it will change the action. The build
prints the state every run and the paragraph carries a working address beside the
form so an applicant is never left with only a route that goes nowhere.
accept is a machine constraint on the picker, not copy shown to a reader — the
spec's own distinction (08-contact.md §6, on the deleted "Minimum 20 characters.").
